## Summary
A crashed or repeated approval phase used to create duplicate OpusClip schedules. It now skips every cell that already has a recorded post.

## Verified
Full suite green.

## Known remaining window
A kill in the milliseconds between reply and write can re-post one cell.

title: opus schedule is re-runnable and statics pass the gate
